areaPersonal.ayuda.descripcion: Guides, frequently asked questions and reading options.
areaPersonal.ayuda.guia.texto: This guide explains the recruitment pool personal area. Home shows deadlines and pending actions. In Recruitment notices, you can review the terms and start an application. The Merits inventory lets you reuse qualifications, experience and documents. The self-assessment of points is provisional and will be reviewed by Human Resources. Payment, signing, registration, call-up, correction and representation actions require confirmation and a receipt.
areaPersonal.ayuda.guia.limiteServicio: Every real operation depends on confirmation from the authorised service.
